headline: Original Yoda puppet hand sells for $15,000
post:
The left hand of Yoda's original puppet from The Empire Strikes Back just sold at Heritage Auctions for $15,000. This piece is made of foam latex and still has marks left by the cane he held inside it.

C-3PO's prop glove actually sold for more money at $17,500. Would you spend that much on this piece of Star Wars history? 🟢

#StarWars #Yoda #TheEmpireStrikesBack
original_title: Yoda Could Lend You a Hand, and This Piece of His Original Empire Strikes Back Puppet Makes It Possible

headline: Roy Thomas originally wanted a 1940s hero for the Avengers
post:
Hey MCU fans! According to /Film, our favorite synthezoid almost had a completely different origin story in the comics. Writer Roy Thomas initially planned to use Aarkus, an interdimensional being from the 1940s who was also called the Vision. 

However, Stan Lee reportedly insisted on an android hero instead. That led Thomas and John Buscema to create the classic character we know today, though he still kept the visual nods and green color scheme of the Golden Age hero. 

It is wild to think how different things would be without that editorial decision, especially regarding his iconic family saga with Ultron and his romance with Wanda Maximoff! 

Would you have wanted to see the 1940s Vision join the team?

#Marvel #Avengers #Vision
original_title: Marvel's Vision Was Originally Intended As A Revival Of A Forgotten Superhero

headline: Supergirl leaves Netflix on December 15th
post:
Hey everyone, we have some bittersweet news for Arrowverse fans. According to ComicBook.com, "The CW’s Supergirl is set to leave Netflix on December 15th". This means U.S. audiences have just one more month to watch all six seasons before the existing licensing deal ends.

Following earlier departures like Arrow and Black Lightning, only The Flash and Legends of Tomorrow will eventually remain on the platform from this era. We still do not know where Kara Danvers will land next, though previous shows like Arrow eventually found a home streaming for free on Pluto TV.

Melissa Benoist led the series as Kara Danvers, bringing wonderful emotional grounding to the role alongside Tyler Hoechlin's Superman. Will you be rewatching any favorite episodes before the series departs next month? #Supergirl #Arrowverse #Netflix
original_title: Netflix Is About to Lose One of DC’s Best Shows and It’s Bad News For Arrowverse Fans
